leads.title: Swiss Glaciers Lose a Fifth of Mass in Five Years
leads.thesis: Swiss glaciers have lost 20% of their ice in just five years, a rate scientists call catastrophic that threatens water, hydropower and Alpine hazards.

leads.title: Endometriosis Drug Shows Early Promise for 190 Million Patients
leads.thesis: Nature reports a new endometriosis drug with early positive results for a disease affecting an estimated 190 million people worldwide that has long been under-treated.

leads.title: Record X-Ray Flash May Capture Magnetar Birth
leads.thesis: Scientists report a record-breaking X-ray flash that may be the first direct observation of a magnetar being born.

leads.title: Quantum Teleportation Team Claims 25-Year Entanglement Hurdle Cleared
leads.thesis: Researchers report cracking a 25-year entanglement challenge to advance quantum teleportation, according to ScienceDaily.

leads.title: Claim: All Unitaries Have Constant-Depth Quantum Circuits
leads.thesis: An arXiv physics paper claims every unitary can be implemented with constant-depth quantum circuits, a result that would upend depth-complexity assumptions.

leads.title: Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text Improves by Removing Timing Shortcuts
leads.thesis: An arXiv AI paper shows non-invasive brain-to-text decoding improves when models are prevented from exploiting timing shortcuts.

leads.title: DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas Maps Every Possible DNA Letter Change
leads.thesis: DeepMind released AlphaGenome Atlas, a predictive map of the effect of every possible single-letter DNA change across the human genome.

leads.title: Anthropic Says It Found a CRISPR-Like System
leads.thesis: Anthropic says it discovered a CRISPR-like gene-editing system using AI, raising questions about AI-driven biology discovery.

leads.title: DeepMind Announces Gemini 4 Argon Frontier Model
leads.thesis: DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon as its next-era frontier intelligence model, signaling a new scaling push.

leads.title: OpenAI Sued Over Hugging Face Hack Fallout
leads.thesis: OpenAI faces a lawsuit over the Hugging Face hack while Hugging Face says it won't 'shoot ourselves in the foot' over fallout, highlighting supply-chain risk in AI infrastructure.

leads.title: ElevenLabs Doubles Valuation to $22 Billion
leads.thesis: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubled its valuation to $22 billion, underscoring investor appetite for synthetic media despite monetization doubts.

leads.title: Reddit Kills RSS and Public API Access, Blaming AI Bots
leads.thesis: Reddit is ending RSS feeds and public API access because of scraping by AI bots, further closing the open web.

leads.title: Google Tests Paying Publishers for AI Search
leads.thesis: Google is reportedly testing paying publishers for content used in AI search features, a potential shift in the AI-publisher bargain.

leads.title: Always-On AI Agents Race: OpenAI Dots vs Meta Muse
leads.thesis: OpenAI's new always-on Dots agents and Meta's Muse signal a race toward proactive, ambient AI that acts without prompting.

leads.title: Trump Medicare Drug Pricing Rule Saves 96% Less Than Proposed
leads.thesis: STAT reports Trump's final Medicare drug pricing rule saves 96% less than the initial proposal, sharply watering down promised savings.

leads.title: Wind and Solar Saved UK £5.9 Billion in Gas Imports During Hormuz Crisis
leads.thesis: Carbon Brief analysis finds UK wind and solar avoided £5.9 billion in gas imports while the Strait of Hormuz was disrupted.

leads.title: Bank of Japan Tankan Shows Sixth Straight Rise in Manufacturer Sentiment
leads.thesis: The BOJ's Tankan survey shows manufacturer sentiment rising for a sixth straight quarter, signaling sustained industrial optimism.

leads.title: Five EU States Plan First Deportation Center in Africa for 2027
leads.thesis: Five EU states plan to open the first joint deportation center in Africa in 2027, a major shift in EU migration policy.

leads.title: Pilot Stabs Colleague on Dubai-Tel Aviv FlyDubai Flight
leads.thesis: A pilot stabbed another pilot on a Dubai to Tel Aviv FlyDubai flight before passengers subdued him, prompting focus on crew-related hijacking risks.

leads.title: US Army Awards Over $4 Billion in Counter-Drone Contracts
leads.thesis: The US Army awarded counter-drone contracts worth more than $4 billion as drone warfare reshapes battlefield needs.

leads.title: Hegseth Unveils Six Major Changes for US Military
leads.thesis: US Defense Secretary Hegseth outlined six major changes for the US military, as debate grows over whether the force is top-heavy with generals.

leads.title: Glasgow Council Fire-and-Rehire of 23,000 Staff After Talks Collapse
leads.thesis: Glasgow council moved to sack 23,000 non-teaching staff and rehire them on new contracts after negotiations broke down, ending a pause in letters.

leads.title: Super El Niño Kelvin Wave Threatens Months of High Seas Off California
leads.thesis: A powerful Kelvin wave triggered by a super El Niño is forecast to raise sea levels off California for months, increasing flood and erosion risk.

leads.title: Some Great Lakes Fish May Live Over 400 Years
leads.thesis: Smithsonian reports research suggesting some Great Lakes fish could live more than 400 years, outliving 15 human generations.

leads.title: Implants That Talk Through Body Tissue as Wiring
leads.thesis: Scientists built a local network of implants that use the human body itself as wiring to communicate, Ars Technica reports.

leads.title: Long Spaceflights Over 90 Days Linked to Higher Hip Fracture Risk
leads.thesis: Phys.org reports studies linking spaceflights longer than 90 days to higher rates of hip fractures in astronauts.

leads.title: Himalayan Hydropower Boom Faces Mounting Insurance Pressures
leads.thesis: Nikkei reports the Himalayan hydropower boom is facing mounting insurance pressures as landslides, floods and glacial risks rise.

leads.title: Synthetic Lethal Drug for Microsatellite Instability Cancers
leads.thesis: Nature Medicine reports a synthetic lethal drug showing promise against microsatellite instability cancers, a common hypermutated type.

leads.title: Medieval Remedy Studied for Antibiotic Resistance Clues
leads.thesis: Science News reports a medieval remedy is being investigated for ideas to combat modern antibiotic resistance.

leads.title: Cutting Sugar Before Antibiotics May Protect Microbiome
leads.thesis: New Scientist reports slashing sugar intake before antibiotics may help preserve the gut microbiome.

leads.title: Complex Brain Waves Reveal Inner Workings
leads.thesis: Quanta Magazine reports surprisingly complex traveling brain waves are revealing new insights into how the brain organizes activity.

leads.title: Critical Zimbra Flaw Exploited to Steal Emails
leads.thesis: Attackers have been actively exploiting a critical Zimbra flaw to steal emails, Ars Technica reports.

leads.title: Cloudflare to Issue Quantum-Safe TLS Certificates
leads.thesis: Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates to prepare the web for post-quantum decryption risks.

leads.title: Google Ads Caught Serving Scareware That Freezes Macs
leads.thesis: Ars Technica reports convincing scareware ads served via Google ads freeze Macs with fake infection warnings.

leads.title: The Virtual Border Wall's Deadly Failures
leads.thesis: MIT Technology Review examines how the US virtual border wall surveillance system has failed and contributed to migrant deaths.

leads.title: OpenAI Reviewing Report of Failed Hack Against Canada Government
leads.thesis: OpenAI says it is reviewing a report of a failed hacking attempt against Canada's government linked to its systems.

leads.title: El Salvador Sets 2027 Election as Bukele Seeks Third Term
leads.thesis: El Salvador set a date for its 2027 presidential election as Nayib Bukele seeks a third term, testing constitutional limits.

leads.title: South Korea Balances Dialogue as North Denies Mine Blast
leads.thesis: South Korea's President Lee balances dialogue offers as North Korea denies responsibility for a mine blast near the border.

leads.title: Palestinians to Bury 105 Killed in Israeli Attack on Gaza
leads.thesis: Palestinians are preparing to bury the remains of 105 people killed in an Israeli attack on Gaza, Al Jazeera reports.

leads.title: Are the Houthis Winning Against Saudi Arabia?
leads.thesis: DW examines whether Yemen's Houthis are gaining advantage against Saudi Arabia as conflict dynamics shift.

leads.title: China's Contenders to Become Its Hugging Face
leads.thesis: Rest of World reports open-source AI platforms in China are vying to become the country's Hugging Face for model sharing.

leads.title: Langtang Lirung Landslide Had Precursory Movement Signals
leads.thesis: Eos reports precursory movement was detected before the 26 August 2026 Langtang Lirung landslide in Nepal, offering lessons for early warning.

leads.title: Doctors Strike in Australia as Pay Dispute Drags On
leads.thesis: Thousands of doctors at public hospitals in an Australian state walked off the job as a pay and conditions dispute remains unresolved.

leads.title: Australia's Biggest Bank Promises No Regional Branch Closures Until 2030
leads.thesis: Australia's biggest bank renewed a commitment to keep regional branches open until at least 2030, addressing access fears in rural areas.
